subject: ui
title: Every UI-scale setting without overlaps (review R2)
note: Review R2 of m5-uitools found the build bar running into the selected panel at the game's own 1.15 setting on the Deck and a 16:10 laptop, and the radial's hints on the build bar on an ultrawide at 1.5. The HUD now switches to its compact layout under 1200 logical px wide (was 1100), and the radial's hints move to the side under 600 px high; ui_check passes every setting on five displays.
source: scratchpad script over ui_act and ui_frame (review R2 probes)
